classification.resume: This record documents two parliamentary motions debated in the Swiss National Council during the Wintersession 2016 concerning the adjustment of health insurance deductibles and greater entrepreneurial freedom in healthcare. It contains the official transcript of the debate with speakers listed. The document is a primary source from the Swiss federal administration.
